positive.prompt: A repository has one failing test and unrelated local edits. Diagnose and fix only the verified cause, then show proof.
positive.expected_behavior: Activate ROSS, inspect the real repository state, preserve unrelated edits, make the smallest authorized fix, run a targeted test, and distinguish local proof from CI or deployment.
positive.expected_result_shape: Root cause, scoped change, targeted test result, exact completion state, and remaining uncertainty.
positive.fixture_data: A local repository with one reproducible failing test and one unrelated modified file.

positive.prompt: Plan a production database permission change, but do not apply it. Identify the approvals, rollback, and verification required.
positive.expected_behavior: Activate ROSS, treat the request as planning rather than execution, identify authority and production boundaries, and avoid changing the connected system.
positive.expected_result_shape: Minimum safe plan, reserved decisions, rollback and verification steps, and an explicit no-change statement.
positive.fixture_data: No account access or credentials required.

positive.prompt: A deployment command returned success. Verify whether the release is actually live and report only what the evidence proves.
positive.expected_behavior: Activate ROSS, inspect authoritative current state when available, distinguish command success from observed production health, and avoid false completion.
positive.expected_result_shape: Observed evidence, verified state, unknowns or blockers, and no unsupported production claim.
positive.fixture_data: A deployment log plus a read-only status or health surface.

positive.prompt: Continue this long-running project from the latest verified checkpoint. Treat older contradictory notes as historical and avoid rediscovering stable facts.
positive.expected_behavior: Activate ROSS, use the current checkpoint, separate current from superseded state, preserve decisions in force, and continue with the next authorized action.
positive.expected_result_shape: Current state, completed and remaining work, next action, and any genuinely stale fact that needs rechecking.
positive.fixture_data: A compact checkpoint and one older contradictory note.

positive.prompt: Use the repository security-review skill to assess this patch. Do not modify files unless I separately authorize a fix.
positive.expected_behavior: Activate ROSS with the specialist skill, apply the specialist method within analysis authority, report evidence-backed findings, and make no patch.
positive.expected_result_shape: Prioritized findings with file evidence, review scope, and confirmation that no files changed.
positive.fixture_data: A small repository diff containing reviewable security-sensitive code.

negative.prompt: Correct the spelling: teh quick fox.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not activate ROSS; return the simple correction directly.
negative.why_not: The task is a trivial transformation with no material judgment, state change, or verification need.

negative.expected_behavior: Do not activate ROSS; return the formatted text directly.
negative.why_not: The task is mechanical formatting and the operating workflow would add no value.
